_description: Deterministic manual-entry input set for the Stage 11-C no-op A/B. Manual entry performs NO live fetch, so identical inputs → identical deck, immune to the price drift that made STAGE_11A_BASELINE.json (ticker path) unusable as a byte-diff target.

rationale.currentSharePriceA=150: THE pivot field. >0 forces every Stage 11-C-changed expression (App.js:851/1310/781, dealCalc.js:29/131/237, deckModel.js:73-84, SectionRelativeContribution.js:70-74) down the SAME branch it took before the edits. The edits only alter the price-ABSENT branch, so with a price present the whole diff is provably a no-op — any A/B drift is therefore a real defect, not data movement.
rationale.cashPercent=60 (40% stock): Non-zero stock consideration ($26,000M x 40% = $10,400M) so newSharesIssued, the ownership split, and the exchange ratio all actually compute (69.3M new shares -> 94%/6% split). Default state value; not a form field.
rationale.synergiesY1/Y2/Y3=600/960/1320: Non-zero synergies exercise the accretion/synergy engine (set explicitly rather than relying on the line-651 auto-fill, so the input set is unambiguous and recorded).
rationale.both companies fully populated: revenue/EBITDA/net income/shares/EPS/cash/debt on both sides so every contribution, P&L, and pro-forma section has real inputs.
